changeSet.sql:
insert into AssetTypeLevel (AssetTypeID,[Level],[Name],[Description]) Select AT.ID,TL.[Level],TL.[Name],TL.Description from AssetType AT inner join TaxonomyTypeLevel TL on AT.ObjectID= TL.TaxonomyTypeID and AT.Object='TaxonomyType' where not exists (Select 1 from AssetTypeLevel where AssetTypeID=AT.ID and Level=TL.[Level] )
insert into AssetTypeLevel (AssetTypeID,[Level],[Name],[Description]) Select AT.ID,TL.[Level],TL.[Name],TL.Description from AssetType AT inner join PolicyTypeLevel TL on AT.ObjectID= TL.PolicyTypeID and AT.Object='PolicyType' where not exists (Select 1 from AssetTypeLevel where AssetTypeID=AT.ID and Level=TL.[Level] )
